scopes.name: entry
scopes.question: 换进去那一笔付了多少
scopes.decision_use: SUNK: paid on the execution bar, unchanged by anything decided today

scopes.name: exit
scopes.question: 今天换回来还要付多少
scopes.decision_use: INCREMENTAL: this is the threshold a 'act again?' decision may use

scopes.name: trip
scopes.question: 一来一回总共多少
scopes.decision_use: CUMULATIVE: answers 'did the discount pay for the whole manoeuvre'

convergence.why: the two columns read the same gap change twice: one charges the entry toll a second time (cumulative), the other charges only what acting again costs. Adding or averaging them prices the trade at 1.5 exchanges

decision.why: only the exit toll moves with 'do I unwind today'; the entry toll is already paid whether this desk acts or not

caveats: the three scopes share one cost figure and one notional; the side counts are imported from r1522 and the cost from the ticket, so a change in either moves all three together

the trigger's window share is REPRODUCED here at its own threshold before the second share is printed: a share at a moved threshold is a measurement, a share at a moved threshold on a series that no longer matches the published one is a new number wearing an old name
the path column re-prices an already published net; it does not re-measure the path and it does not re-derive the gain
a pair the trigger does not publish carries no share and is named, not printed as 0
sentence: 同一个成本在读三个范围：进 0.16pp（已付、沉没）、出 0.16pp（今天再动才付）、一来一回 0.32pp——这一次进出各 ￥251，合计 ￥502。 判「要不要再动一次」只能用 0.16pp；按它算净额是 ￥-296，按一来一回算是 ￥-547，两个数不能相加也不能平均。
